newsitem.title: USA: Safeskin says to expand Asian operations.
newsitem.headline: Safeskin says to expand Asian operations.

text.p: Safeskin Corp said it will invest $40 million to expand its Southeast Asian manufacturing operations.

It said it expects the expansion over the next two years to increase production capacity at its existing Thailand manufacturing facility by over one billion exam gloves per year with the construction of an additional building and related machinery. It also plans to construct a second manufacturing facility to be located in southern Thailand that is expected to produce examination, surgical and high technology and scientific gloves.
Almost $20 million of the total planned investment will be made in 1997, Safeskin said.
